payload.title: File:Konkasaurus mahalana (holotype, CT summary).jpg
payload.artist_html: E. L. Stanley, K. L Fenner, J. D. Daza, M. P. Heinicke, J. S. Arias & D. W. Krause
payload.credit_html: "New insights into the phylogenetic position and palaeobiogeography of Konkasaurus mahalana (Squamata: Scincoidea) from the Late Cretaceous of Madagascar"
payload.description_html: MicroCT scan of the largest block of the holotype (UA 8715) of Konkasaurus mahalana. a, isolated elements, including: b, dentary (above, medial view) and postdentary (below, medial view) bones; c, maxillary fragment, ventral view; d, left ilium (medial view); e, left ischium (medial view); f, simple osteoderms (external surfaces); g, putative compound osteoderms; h, a distal caudal vertebra (clockwise from top left, left lateral, right lateral, rostral, and ventral views); and i, proximal caudal vertebra (posterior view). Abbreviations: add.fs, adductor fossa; ait, anterior iliac tubercle; ar.fac, articular facet; aut.sept, autotomal septum; cot, vertebral cotyle; sds, subdental shelf; tp, transverse process (caudal rib); zga, zygantrum.
